results.tailwind_config: fontFamily: { display: ['Inter', 'sans-serif'], quote: ['Playfair Display', 'serif'], mono: ['JetBrains Mono', 'monospace'] }
results.notes: Tri-stack: Inter 600–800 for all UI (letterSpacing -1.5px heroes, -0.5px subheads). Playfair Display Italic ONLY for pull quotes. JetBrains Mono for labels and stats. Scale: 12px labels, 16px body, 22px sub, 32px section, 40px H2, 56px H1, 72px Hero Statement. 5:1 ratio H1:Body is mandatory. lineHeight 1.1 headlines, 1.6 body. Underlines (2–3pt accent) replace buttons for interactions.
Bebas Neue for large headlines only. All-caps display font.

System-first strategy: Inter as primary, falls back to system SF/Roboto on iOS/Android. Scale: Headlines fontWeight 800 letterSpacing -0.5; Subheadings fontWeight 600 fontSize 18; Body fontWeight 400 lineHeight 24; Labels fontWeight 700 uppercase letterSpacing 1. Thick weights carry all hierarchy since there are no shadows. Use aggressive size contrast (poster rule: body 16pt vs headline 40pt+). Avoid italic.
